from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others={v:c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg}
    marker=min(others,key=lambda v:others[v])
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    scols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    def split(seps,n):
        rs=[]; cur=0
        for s in seps:
            if s>cur: rs.append((cur,s)); cur=s+1
        if cur<n: rs.append((cur,n))
        return rs
    rows=split(sr,H); cols=split(scols,W)
    cand=[(sum(1 for r in range(a,b) for q in range(c,d) if g[r][q]==marker),(a,b,c,d)) for (a,b) in rows for (c,d) in cols]
    n,(a,b,c,d)=max(cand)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(a,b):
        for q in range(c,d): out[r][q]=marker
    for r in range(H):
        for q in range(W):
            if out[r][q]==marker and not(a<=r<b and c<=q<d): out[r][q]=bg
    return out

from collections import Counter
def analyze(g):
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others={v:c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg}
    marker=min(others,key=lambda v:others[v])
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    scols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    def split(seps,n):
        rs=[]; cur=0
        for s in seps:
            if s>cur: rs.append((cur,s)); cur=s+1
        if cur<n: rs.append((cur,n))
        return rs
    rows=split(sr,H); cols=split(scols,W)
    cand=[(sum(1 for r in range(a,b) for q in range(c,d) if g[r][q]==marker),(a,b,c,d)) for (a,b) in rows for (c,d) in cols]
    print('counts',sorted(cand,reverse=True)[:4],'rows',rows,'cols',scols)
    return bg,marker,cands:=None

from collections import Counter,deque
def solve2(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others={v:c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg}
    marker=min(others,key=lambda v:others[v])
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]; scols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    def split(seps,n):
        rs=[]; cur=0
        for s in seps:
            if s>cur: rs.append((cur,s)); cur=s+1
        if cur<n: rs.append((cur,n))
        return rs
    rows=split(sr,H); cols=split(scols,W)
    # count markers per cell position (row-block, col-block) -> sum over whole block of marker cells at that (rowband,colband)?
    # rule from demo4: pick row-band with most total markers, then col-band with most total markers within it? test.
    best_r=None; brs=[]
    for a,b in rows:
        nb=sum(1 for r in range(a,b) for q in range(W) if g[r][q]==marker)
        if best_r is None or nb>best_r[0]: best_r=(nb,(a,b))
    (a,b)=best_r[1]
    bc=[(sum(1 for r in range(a,b) for q in range(c,d) if g[r][q]==marker),(c,d)) for c,d in cols]
    n,(c,d)=max(bc)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(a,b):
        for q in range(c,d): out[r][q]=marker
    for r in range(H):
        for q in range(W):
            if out[r][q]==marker and not(a<=r<b and c<=q<d): out[r][q]=bg
    return out

def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    others={v:c for v,c in cnt.items() if v!=bg}
    marker=min(others,key=lambda v:others[v])
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    sr=[r for r in range(H) if len(set(g[r]))==1]
    scols=[c for c in range(W) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(H)})==1]
    def split(seps,n):
        rs=[]; cur=0
        for s in seps:
            if s>cur: rs.append((cur,s)); cur=s+1
        if cur<n: rs.append((cur,n))
        return rs
    rows=split(sr,H); cols=split(scols,W)
    cand=[(sum(1 for r in range(a,b) for q in range(c,d) if g[r][q]==marker),(a,b,c,d)) for (a,b) in rows for (c,d) in cols]
    n,(a,b,c,d)=max(cand)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r in range(a,b):
        for q in range(c,d): out[r][q]=marker
    for r in range(H):
        for q in range(W):
            if out[r][q]==marker and not(a<=r<b and c<=q<d): out[r][q]=bg
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
from collections import Counter,deque
ti=G['Test input']; H,W=len(ti),len(ti[0])
cnt=Counter(x for r in ti for x in r); print(cnt)

def solve(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # find full uniform rows / cols (separator lines) not equal to majority bg
    # majority = most common
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    val=g[0][sc[0]] if sc else None
    print('bg',bg,'val',val,'sr',sr,'sc',sc)
    def blocks():
        rs=[-1]+sr+[H]; cs=[-1]+sc+[W]
        for bi in range(len(rs)-1):
            for bj in range(len(cs)-1):
                r0,r1=rs[bi]+1,rs[bi+1]-1
                c0,c1=cs[bj]+1,cs[bj+1]-1
                yield r0,r1,c0,c1
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in blocks():
        cells=[(i,j,g[r0+i+c0-r0][c0+j]) for i in range(r1-r0+1) for j in range(c1-c0+1)]
        v=Counter(vv for _,_,vv in cells)
        odd=[vv for cnt,vv in v.items() if vv!=bg and cnt<v.get(bg,0)*0 or True]
        # rare colors
        rare=sorted((cnt,x) for x,cnt in v.items() if x!=bg and x!=val)
        if rare:
            x=rare[-1][1]
            rr=[i for i,j,vv in cells if vv==x]
            cc=[j for i,j,vv in cells if vv==x]
            # shape bounding box: fill rectangle [minr..maxr]x[c0..c1]? demo says block becomes filled with x in some region
            mi,mj,maxi,maxj=min(rr),min(cc),max(rr),max(cc)
            h=maxi-mi+1; w=maxj-mj+1
            # try candidate placements
            best=None
            for pr in range(r0,maxi+1):
                for pc in range(c0,maxj+1):
                    ok=True
                    for i in range(h):
                        for j in range(w):
                            if rr[i-mi]==mi and False: pass
                        pass
                    if ok: best=(pr,pc)
            # simpler: fill bottom-right anchor area: choose pr,pc minimizing mismatch to pattern
            res=[]
            for pr in range(max(0,r0+1-maxi),r1-h+1):

                    if ok: res.append((pr,pc))
            res.sort(key=lambda t:(t[0],t[1]))
            best=res[0] if res else None
            print(n,(r0,c0),(h,w),best)
    return out

def solve3(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sr=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if len(set(r))==1]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(H)})==1]
    sepv={g[i][0] for i in sr}|{g[0][j] for j in sc}
    rs=[-1]+sr+[H]; cs=[-1]+sc+[W]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for bi in range(len(rs)-1):
        row=[]
        for bj in range(len(cs)-1):
            r0,r1=rs[bi]+1,rs[bi+1]-1
            c0,c1=cs[bj]+1,cs[bj+1]-1
            v=Counter(g[i][j] for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1))
            rr={x for x in v if x!=bg and x not in sepv}
            fc=max(rr,key=lambda x:v[x]) if rr else None
            row.append((sum(v[x] for x in rr) if rr else -1,fc,bj,(r0,r1),(c0,c1)))
        mx=max(c[0] for c in row)
        for _,_,bj,bb,_ in row:
            if c[0]==mx:

                out[r0:r1+1][c0:c1+1]=[max(rr,key=lambda x:v[x])]* ((r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1))
